_meta.description: Read-back proof of the io.datahub.agentMemory.learnings structured property values written to the real fct_orders dataset urn and its amount schemaField urn, produced by executing the retain workflow (skill/datahub-memory/SKILL.md Workflow 2, Steps 3-4) exactly as specified: read-merge-write against a confirmed-empty starting state, one add_structured_properties call per entity, full value list each time.
_meta.produced_by: demo-seed/wave4 (scripted seed run, producing this repo's examples/ deliverable, not one of the video's Agent A / Agent B personas)
_meta.method: DataHub MCP server (uvx mcp-server-datahub@latest, TOOLS_IS_MUTATION_ENABLED=true) called over stdio: add_structured_properties for each write, then raw GraphQL (entity { structuredProperties { properties { values } } }) for the readback shown below -- the same tool surface skill/datahub-memory/references/mcp-tools-reference.md documents.
_meta.each_value_below: Shown parsed for readability. On the wire each is a single-line JSON string (json.dumps(..., separators=(',', ':'))) -- that raw string form is what DataHub actually stores as one structured-property value.

table_level_learnings.claim: 'Revenue' = status='completed' orders only (excludes cancelled and refunded), amount/100, summed by order_date.
table_level_learnings.evidence: Cross-checked against finance dashboard for 3 distinct months; all three matched within $1.

table_level_learnings.claim: Monthly revenue: SELECT SUM(amount)/100.0 FROM fct_orders WHERE status='completed' AND date_trunc('month', order_date)=:month
table_level_learnings.evidence: June 2026 result ($38,604,332.17) matched finance dashboard export to the cent.

field_level_learnings.claim: Values are stored in cents, not dollars; divide by 100 for a dollar amount.
field_level_learnings.evidence: SUM(amount) for completed June 2026 orders = 3,860,433,217 vs. finance dashboard $38,604,332; ratio exactly 100.
